'''Exodeen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].

==Description==
Exodeen was the first major occupied world in a string of planets of the Colonies encountered on the Hydian's route, followed by [[Boudolayz]], [[Herzob]], [[Besnia system/Legends|Besnia]], and [[Koensayr]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was home to a non-humanoid [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Exodeenian]]s who had six arms, six legs, and six rows of uneven teeth.<ref name="TNR" />

==History==
Exodeen was located in the middle of Imperial territory circa the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While some Exodeenians served within the bureaucracy of the Empire, others were members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="TNR" />

Exodeen was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by senior senator [[M'yet Luure]], a [[Unidentified Exodeen secondary senator|secondary senator]], and finally junior senator [[R'yet Coome]].<ref name="TNR" /> The world later [[Battle of the Exodeen system|fell]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]].<ref name="TEA" />
